svg.title: Step 3: reading 94 files in 6 formats
svg.desc: Text files (24 SQL snapshots, 28 JSON exports, 26 logs and 1 text record) are read by plain code. Pictures (11 screenshots and 4 PDFs) are read by an AI model. Both become one list of facts, and every fact remembers which file it came from and when.
svg.text: Text files are read by plain code. Screenshots and PDFs are read by an AI model.
from: activity log · Jun 2026 · only a claim
Every fact remembers which file it came from, and when.
